description: Connect authorized Awtsmoos accounts and devices, discover current instructions, manage verified work, inspect permitted files, and share approved artifacts safely.

defaultPrompt: B"H, connect to my authorized Awtsmoos device and check its status.
Ask the Awtsmoos tunnel which instructions apply to my task.
Create a saved Awtsmoos plan with a verification checklist.
interface.longDescription: Awtsmoos Shliach (Agent) connects authorized Awtsmoos accounts and devices to discover live instructions, inspect status, read and write permitted files, run separately authorized commands, capture Merkava/Chrome browser screenshots and temporarily publish any individually approved authorized file (subject to size, scope and path restrictions) through short-lived, revocable binary resource links with MIME, size and SHA-256 verification. Remote actions require OAuth scopes, account ownership and live device permissions. Publishing files publicly requires explicit approval and tunnel.admin scope; URLs are accessible to their holders until expiry or revocation. No plugin installation charge or in-plugin checkout. The separate Awtsmoos service may track Peruta usage credits and return external purchase/upgrade links. The Awtsmoos worldview and artistic voice are preserved in the installed writing skills.
interface.shortDescription: Authorized Awtsmoos tools, plans and verified artifact sharing

publication.release_notes: 0.93.0 submission candidate: exactly 5 positive/3 negative reviews; generic action discovery, any individually approved authorized file as checksum-verified temporary artifact, Merkava/Chrome capture, binary HTTPS, identity-safe CLI. Host auto-import remains platform-dependent.

review.commerce_description: No plugin installation charge or in-plugin checkout.
